thread:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — noticed some users still had app access after an offboard. IdP sent a SCIM PATCH but the app didn't drop the mapped groups. Anyone familiar with our SCIM attribute mapping that turns SAML groups into internal team tags?

Devon: @Morgan can you paste the SCIM payload and any log snippets? Did the IdP send an 'active': false or did they remove group membership?

Morgan: Pasted a redacted payload below. We got 200 from /scim/v2/Users/1234 but groups stayed attached. Logs show the PATCH then an apply step that complains about a missing group.

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "replace",
    "path": "groups",
    "value": [{"value":"team-foo","display":"Team Foo"}]
  }]
}
```

Hana: Two quick checks: 1) our syncer looks for groups under the core User -> groups path (exact casing) and 2) we normalize group external IDs to lowercase before matching. If OKTA sends a different casing we can miss it.

Ashwin: We recently tightened create behavior so unknown groups don't get auto-created — that meant the apply step would skip silently and leave the old memberships. I pushed a log change earlier this month but maybe it didn't catch this code path. Grep for 'normalization error' or 'group create skipped'.

Morgan: Grepped logs: "normalization error: externalId mismatch: 'Team-Foo' != 'team-foo'" then "apply_groups: group lookup failed for team-foo". So it's a mismatch, not a permission problem. :eyes:

Devon: Nice catch. Short-term fix: add a lowercase normalization when reading incoming group values. Long-term: make the matcher case-insensitive and surface a noisy error so oncall sees it.

Ashwin: I'll own the patch. I'll also flip the log level to ERROR for "group create skipped" so it doesn't silently hide during offboards. If the syncer sees a mismatch on deprovision it should trigger a full reconciliation job.

Morgan: Thanks. I'm kicking a manual full sync now to clean up the affected accounts. Command I ran: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/syncer/reconcile -d '{"type":"full"}'`

scim-syncer-bot: job 71234 queued — full sync started, 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z

Devon: @Ashwin please ping me when you open the PR so I can review (small change). If you want I can also add a unit test for the lowercase normalization.

Ashwin: Will do. If the full sync fixes the offboarded accounts we'll close this out. If not, I'll escalate to oncall for live debugging.

Morgan: Confirmed after the sync a couple of users lost access as expected. Leaving this thread open until the matcher change is in. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
